_about: What each bot-driven seat makes at the induction terminal (TEST FIXTURES, never proposals for the six real kids: PT- names, deleted with the world). Ids are from data/campaign/{ancestry,background,class}-catalogue.json. `free` is the four free attribute boosts (they must differ); `keyAbility` is for the one class with a real choice. `backgroundChoice` and `classChoice` answer the question a background or class asks (Starship Dweller: Crafting or Piloting; Envoy: Deception, Diplomacy or Intimidation); without one the bot takes the first option. `portrait` is a file in tools/playtest/assets/. `fill` types into the optional questions too; `blank` leaves every optional field empty.
